// releases: The releases page every artefact points at: <releases>/latest/download/<file>, <releases>/download/v<version>/<file>. install.sh carries the same default; NIMBO_INSTALL_BASE overrides it at install and upgrade time.
// mcpb: The official MCP bundle CLI that validates and packs the MCP bundle (tools/release/mcpb.mjs), run with npm exec at this exact version.
// prune: Packages a production install carries that nothing in the app loads: DuckDB-WASM is bundled into the UI build, and the native DuckDB binding is installed on demand (nimbo sql install).
// runtime: Packages of which only a part runs in the app, with the dependencies that part loads: the CLI and the daemon import @jsnb/output-view's model alone, and @jsnb/ui ships its built dist.
// typesAtRuntime: Declaration files the daemon's language service reads at run time: TypeScript's own lib files and Node's types for server cells. Every other .d.ts is left out of a release.
// uiAssets: Files the UI build copies from a package as they are (no source map names them), by file name: their package's licence goes into THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.
// licences: The licences a bundled package may have. A package outside them, or without a licence text, fails the build unless declared: `ids` gives the SPDX id of a package whose package.json states none (its licence file says it), `texts` names where a package's licence text is when it carries none: a file under tools/release/, or the package of the same project that holds it.
